name: Interest Type 3 Code
definition: Indicates whether interest rate is fixed, variable or other.

ZCPN.name: Zero Coupon
ZCPN.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is a zero coupon.

FIXD.name: Fixed
FIXD.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is fixed.

FLRN.name: Floating Rate Note
FLRN.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is a floating rate note.

DUAL.name: Dual Basis
DUAL.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is a dual basis.

INDE.name: Index
INDE.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is index.

DSCO.name: Discounted
DSCO.definition: Indicates that the type of interest is discounted.
